runtimeAndUpdateStatus: Mkhalidwe wa kagwiridwe ntchito ndi zosintha
statusPanelIntro: Lipoti la thanzi la dongosolo lotengera tebulo la mkhalidwe la woyang'anira, pogwiritsa ntchito makiyi oyenera kumbuyo kwa makhazikitsidwe a PHP ndi NodeJS.
skeletonsPanelIntro: Yatsani kapena zimitsani mafupa a webusayiti opezeka kuchokera ku malo a mndandanda wa mafupa.

integrationsPanelIntro: Konzani ziphaso za API ndi zokhazikika za kulumikizana zogwiritsidwa ntchito ndi zofalitsa ndi zinthu zodzichitira zokha.
apiKeysSectionDescription: Yang'anirani makiyi a API a opereka ntchito ogwiritsidwa ntchito pa zofalitsa ndi kulumikizana kwa AI. Makiyi amasungidwa pa seva mu _config/apiKeys.json.
mediaPanelIntro: Ikani zokhazikika za ubwino wa chithunzi, malire okweza, ndi kasinthidwe.
mediaPolicySectionDescription: Zokonda za ndondomeko ya zofalitsa zimasungidwa m'zokonda za zofalitsa za dongosolo.
configurationPanelIntro: Ikani chilankhulo chokhazikika cha mawebusayiti atsopano ndi zokhazikika zina za kakonzedwe ka dongosolo lonse.
localizationSectionDescription: Zokhazikika za kumasulira kwa malo zimasungidwa mu chipika cha localization cha kakonzedwe ka dongosolo.
styleGuidePanelIntro: Zowongolera kalozera wa kalembedwe zazimitsidwa dala pamene thandizo la kumbuyo likumalizidwa.
